summary: InMed Pharmaceuticals filed an 8-K to report receiving a Nasdaq notice that it regained compliance with the $1.00 minimum bid price requirement for continued listing on the Nasdaq Capital Market. The company had previously been notified of non-compliance on March 27, 2026. The notice confirmed that the closing bid price was at or above $1.00 for 10 consecutive business days from May 19 to June 2, 2026. A press release announcing the compliance was issued on June 4, 2026. This is a routine listing compliance update with no acquisition, divestiture, or other special situation.
